opportunities.specific_product: Mamma Mia waterproof stretch sofa cover
opportunities.transformation_hook: Hide a stained, pet-hair couch for $42 in one Sunday afternoon
opportunities.before_state: Faded, stained sofa covered in pet hair, claw snags, and mismatched throw blankets hiding the damage
opportunities.after_state: Crisp, tailored-looking couch in a color that matches the room, no visible pet hair
opportunities.why_now: Fall nesting season and back-to-school routines put pets back on furniture full-time, and Mamma Mia's 24-30% commission makes this the highest-margin evergreen pick to push right now.

opportunities.why_now: HGTV's underutilized-space storage content is surfacing on Pinterest right alongside back-to-school reset pins, and September is the peak home-organization search window.
